source.quote: Audiophonics' own product page, read 2026-11-27. USB-powered DAC: converter « ESS Sabre ES9018K2M », USB receiver « SAVIAUDIO SA9227 », rates « 32bit / 384kHz / DSD64 », and the text says the DSD64 is native (« DSD64 natif »). Outputs: 3.5 mm jack and a mini-Toslink optical output (« 24bit/96kHz »). No other input than USB.

facts.chip: ESS ES9018K2M, behind a SaviAudio SA9227 USB receiver.

_maker_terms: See brands/audiophonics.json: the maker's terms forbid reproduction; recorded on the project owner's decision of 2026-11-27, pending written permission.
_the_optical_socket_is_an_OUTPUT: The mini-Toslink is a digital output (24/96), not an input, so no spdif_optical block is written.
